newsitem.title: USA: Canmax targets $9.5 mln Southland contract.
newsitem.headline: Canmax targets $9.5 mln Southland contract.

text.p: Canmax Inc said on Monday that it has a letter of intent with NCR Corp to develop for Southland Corp a version of the Canmax "C-Serve" convenience store software for $9.5 million.
The company said project revenues to Canmax will come in over an 11-month period that ends April 1997.

"To put this in perspective, this 11-month project has a value that exceeds our entire FY 1995 revenues," said Conmax Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Philip Parsons, adding that the money "contributes to accelerating our revenue and earnings growth objectives."
The company reported revenues of $3.4 million and $0.05 earnings per share in the third quarter ending July 31.
The Irving, Texas-based company supplies information and automation solutions to the convenience and retail petroleum industries.
It was trading at 2 3/4 late Monday afternoon.
